scans.name: Bottom Bounce
scans.f: Hammer 5-din ke Low par ya Shooting star 5-din ke High par, 50-din avg turnover > 3 crore

scans.name: Pullback
scans.f: EMA(9) > EMA(20), Volume > 1,00,000, Open > 50, EMA(9) > Close

scans.name: Breakout
scans.f: Close monthly R1 ke 94% se 99% ke beech

scans.name: Reversal 2.0
scans.f: Aaj Close > Open, pichle 4 din ke Close lagatar gire, Open > 100, Volume > 30,000

scans.name: Nice Bottom
scans.f: Close >= 20 aur Low pichle 100 din ka sabse neecha (Market Cap >= 100 data na hone se nahi lagaya, Close <= SMA(200) band tha)

scans.name: Market Top
scans.f: 3 din lagatar Close > Open, RSI(14) > 50, SMA5 > SMA20, 2 din lagatar High upar, Volume > 20-din avg, 20-din avg turnover > 2 crore. 40+ stocks wali date alag highlight
